events.title: Trinity & Hiroshima
events.description: U.S. tests first device; drops two bombs. Sole nuclear power.

events.title: Soviet First Test
events.description: USSR detonates Joe-1. Monopoly ends; mutual deterrence begins.

events.title: Hydrogen Bomb
events.description: U.S. thermonuclear test — yield 500× Hiroshima. Arms race escalates.

events.title: Sputnik & ICBM
events.description: USSR launches first satellite and proves intercontinental delivery. No city is safe.

events.title: Cuban Missile Crisis
events.description: Thirteen days at the edge. Both sides defect — then pull back.

events.title: SALT I Signed
events.description: First strategic arms limitation. Cooperation emerges from mutual exhaustion.

events.title: START I & Soviet Collapse
events.description: Deep cuts treaty signed. Cold War ends — dilemma dissolves with one player.
